entries.description: Continuation of a 17-acre community with 3 resident lesbians, housing, electricity, and farm land, engaged in organic gardening, survival skills, and winter outdoor activities, welcoming new members, non-lesbian women, and children.
entries.raw_text: holistic health, survival skills, yoga, and organic gardening. Winter activities include skiing (x-country and downhill), horse drawn sleigh rides, cozy fireplace, music and dance. We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, dogs, horses. We have/are: 3 lesbians, 17 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping spaces, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Continuation from previous page. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative based on '3 lesbians... women living and working on the land' and 'We welcome: new members/residents'. num_residents is 3 based on '3 lesbians' and 'women living and working on the land'. entries.description: A 21-acre community in Monticello, New York, with 5 resident lesbians building recreation and independent living for disabled people, welcoming new members, non-lesbian women, and children, with plans to open to disabled men in the future.
entries.raw_text: THE BEACHTREE RD 1 Box 98, Monticello, NY 12701 (914)794-6121. Disabled lesbians trying to build recreation — independent living for disabled. Land will be opening to disabled men within next two years. We welcome women, donations, work exchange, no space in house available now. Possible openings in May. (No smoking in house). We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, dogs. We have/are: 5 lesbians, 21 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living on the land.
entries.notes: RD address indicates land location. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative based on 5 lesbians living on land and welcoming new members. Men are mentioned as planned for the future ('within next two years'), not currently accepted. Focus Disabled women coded for 'Disabled lesbians trying to build recreation — independent living for disabled'.

entries.description: A 22-acre unimproved property in north central Pennsylvania owned by an individual lesbian based in Philadelphia, seeking people to develop the land in exchange for a long-term lease.
entries.raw_text: SUSAN STONE 124 Maplewood Ave, Philadelphia, PA 19144. I have 22 acres of land in north central PA. There is a spring site, but it needs to be developed. The land is ½ wooded and ½ clear. Electricity is available. There are no improvements to the property. I would be interested in having people develop the land in return for a long term lease. I welcome: letters. I have/am: 1 lesbian, 22 acres, camping space, woods, farm land.
entries.notes: No community name given; listed under personal name SUSAN STONE. Land is in 'north central PA' while contact address is in Philadelphia. num_residents is 0 because there are 'no improvements to the property' and owner lives in Philadelphia. Type is Private/Individual Land owned by one woman.

entries.description: A 20-acre community with 10 resident lesbians focusing on self-sufficiency, spirituality, rituals, and workshops, welcoming new members, girl children, boy children on the second weekend of each month, and non-lesbian women who accept the community's lesbian focus.
entries.raw_text: TURTLE LAND FOR WIMMIN 719 N Irving St, Arlington, VA 22201 (703)527-7396. Our goal is to create a diverse, fun, spiritually and politically conscious community living in harmony with nature and as self-sufficient as possible. Some retreats, workshops, music, rituals, etc. are going on already. A one room hexagon cabin should be finished by Summer '83. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, boy children (only the 2nd weekend of each month), nonlesbian women who accept that men are not welcome and accept our lesbian identification, dogs. We have/are: 10 lesbians, 20 acres, camping space, woods, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: City street address in Arlington VA appears to be a contact address rather than the rural 20-acre land itself. land_state inferred as VA from contact state. num_residents is 10 based on '10 lesbians' and 'women living and working on the land'. Focuses coded: Spirituality/ritual ('spiritually and politically conscious community', 'rituals'), Farming/self-sufficiency ('as self-sufficient as possible'), Workshops/education ('workshops'). Boy children accepted conditionally: 'only the 2nd weekend of each month'.

entries.description: A 50-acre property in Pittsboro, North Carolina, owned by an individual lesbian planning to move there by next summer, aiming to create a haven for older lesbians and welcoming new members and girl children.
entries.raw_text: DUFFY Z BAUM PO Box 678, Carrboro, NC 27510 (919)942-5340. I own 50 acres of land in Pittsboro, NC. I am building a house on the land and also have an old house on the land. I do not live on my land but hope to by next summer. I am anxious to have other women join me on my land. The land is quite isolated and has some nice big old trees. I'd like to be a haven for older dykes. I welcome: new members/residents, girl children. I have/am: 1 lesbian, 50 acres, electricity, camping space, woods, farm land (questionable).
entries.notes: Listed under personal name DUFFY Z BAUM. Land is explicitly stated as in Pittsboro, NC. num_residents is 0 because 'I do not live on my land but hope to by next summer'. Type is Private/Individual Land because owner does not live there yet. Focus Older women coded for 'haven for older dykes'.

entries.description: A 100-acre substance-free community and farm in Luttrell, Tennessee, with 4 resident lesbians (two members and two renters), housing the Tennessee Lesbian Archives, and welcoming visitors and girl children.
entries.raw_text: OKRA RIDGE FARM Rt 2 Box 252, Luttrell, TN 37779 (615)992-8423. Currently two members and two renters. Drug/alcohol-free space. Support and house the Tennessee Lesbian Archives. Visitors welcome for 1-3 days, but WRITE OR CALL FIRST; be prepared to work and contribute financially if you can. No smoking in main house or Archives. We welcome: girl children. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 100 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing, electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Rural route address is the land. num_residents is 4 based on 'Currently two members and two renters' and '4 lesbians... women living and working on the land'. Focuses coded: Recovery/substance-free ('Drug/alcohol-free space') and Archives/cultural work ('Support and house the Tennessee Lesbian Archives').

entries.description: A 300-acre developing women's community near Monticello, Kentucky, with 12 lesbians and 2 non-lesbian women, welcoming new members, non-lesbian women, and girl children.
entries.raw_text: SPIRAL PO Box 337, Monticello, KY 42633 (606)348-5215. Spiral in essence is change. Spiral is in the process of creating an alternative wimmins community. We welcome constructive input/feedback to aide in our growth. Prefer wimmin write or call before visit. We welcome: new members, girl children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 12 lesbians, 2 nonlesbians, 300 acres, camping space, woods (250 acres), farmland (30 acres).
entries.notes: PO Box address, so land street and zip are blank; land state inferred as KY. num_residents left blank per codebook because listing does not specify that women are living on the land (counts '12 lesbians, 2 nonlesbians'). Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('in the process of creating an alternative wimmins community', welcoming new members).

entries.description: A 2.3-acre homestead in Granville, Ohio, lived on by two lesbians starting an organic garden and envisioning mutual support through collective work, welcoming children, non-lesbian women, and non-oppressive men for short visits.
entries.raw_text: ADLAI NEUBAUER & KAREN HAMM 3634 Loudon St, Granville, OH 43023 (614)587-4527. We are only beginning. We have a small piece of land and the start of an organic garden. We envision a community of women supporting each other emotionally, spiritually and financially through responsible collective work. Visitors should plan to stay a maximum of two nights unless a work exchange or other arrangements are made (2 week advance notice preferred). No drug addicts/alcoholics, kleptomaniacs, or other disrespectful people welcome. We welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, non oppressive males (not overnight), dogs. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 2.3 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, farm land, women living on the land.
entries.notes: Listed under personal names ADLAI NEUBAUER & KAREN HAMM. Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('2 lesbians... women living on the land', welcoming visitors but not actively recruiting new residents). num_residents is 2. Males accepted conditionally: 'non oppressive males (not overnight)', coded as Gay men and Non-gay men. Focus Recovery/substance-free coded for 'No drug addicts/alcoholics'.

entries.community_name: SUSAN B ANTHONY MEMORIAL UNREST HOME
entries.description: A 150-acre community in Millfield, Ohio, with two resident lesbians seeking feminist pioneers to build a rural community, especially encouraging older women, and welcoming new members, non-lesbian women, and children.
entries.raw_text: SUSAN B ANTHONY MEMORIAL UNREST HOME Rt 1 Box 215, Millfield, OH 45761. Feminist pioneers wanted to begin women's rural community in southeast Ohio. Send long SASE for brochure. Older feminists especially encouraged to respond. We welcome written (or taped) inquiries and correspondence. No drop ins or surprise telephone requests for overnight accommodations. We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children (only during July), nonlesbian women, older women especially welcome. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 150 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, primitive camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Rural route address is the land. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because the 2 resident lesbians are actively recruiting new members ('Feminist pioneers wanted to begin women's rural community', 'We welcome: new members/residents'). num_residents is 2 based on '2 lesbians... women living and working on the land'. Focus Older women coded for 'Older feminists especially encouraged to respond' and 'older women especially welcome'. Boy children accepted conditionally: 'only during July'.
